summary: 2026-05-07 arXiv daily selected 4 papers for follow-up.
highlights: ConsisVLA-4D: Advancing Spatiotemporal Consistency in Efficient 3D-Perception and 4D-Reasoning for Robotic Manipulation: 面向机器人操作提出 ConsisVLA-4D，通过 3D 感知与 4D 推理的一致性设计提升 VLA 性能并显著加速推理。
Dream-MPC: Gradient-Based Model Predictive Control with Latent Imagination: Dream-MPC 用学习到的 world model 与梯度优化式 MPC 提升连续控制中的策略与规划性能。
From Pixels to Tokens: A Systematic Study of Latent Action Supervision for Vision-Language-Action Models: 系统比较图像式与动作式 latent action 监督策略，指出离散 latent action token 直接监督 VLM 的 VLA 训练效果最佳。

items.title: ConsisVLA-4D: Advancing Spatiotemporal Consistency in Efficient 3D-Perception and 4D-Reasoning for Robotic Manipulation
items.summary: 面向机器人操作提出 ConsisVLA-4D，通过 3D 感知与 4D 推理的一致性设计提升 VLA 性能并显著加速推理。
items.abstract_en: Current Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models primarily focus on mapping 2D observations to actions, but exhibit notable limitations in spatiotemporal perception and reasoning: 1) spatial representations often rely on additional sensors, introducing substantial computational overhead; 2) visual reasoning is typically limited to future-frame prediction, lacking alignment with the instruction-grounded scene and thus compromising spatiotemporal consistency. To address these challenges, we propose ConsisVLA-4D, a unified and efficient framework that enhances spatiotemporal consistency in 3D perception and 4D reasoning. Specifically, we design: 1) CV-Aligner, which ensures cross-view object semantic consistency by filtering instruction-relevant regions and aligning object identities across multiple viewpoints; 2) CO-Fuser, which guarantees cross-object spatial geometric consistency by eliminating spatial relation ambiguities between objects across views using compact latent representations. Building upon these, we introduce 3) CS-Thinker to achieve cross-scene spatiotemporal consistency as actions unfold. It learns implicit knowledge of local dynamics from object-semantic tokens of CV-Aligner and global depth from geometric tokens of CO-Fuser, thereby enhancing efficient visual reasoning under scene variations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that, benefiting from its efficient spatiotemporal consistency design, ConsisVLA-4D achieves 21.6% and 41.5% performance improvements, along with 2.3-fold and 2.4-fold inference speedups compared to OpenVLA on the LIBERO benchmark and real-world platforms, respectively.ConsisVLA-4D is open-sourced and publicly available at
items.one_liner_zh: 面向机器人操作提出 ConsisVLA-4D，通过 3D 感知与 4D 推理的一致性设计提升 VLA 性能并显著加速推理。
items.summary_cn: 当前的 Vision-Language-Action (VLA) 模型主要关注将 2D 观测映射到动作，但在时空感知与推理方面存在明显局限：1）空间表示通常依赖额外传感器，带来显著的计算开销；2）视觉推理通常局限于未来帧预测，缺乏与指令驱动场景的对齐，因此削弱了时空一致性。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了 ConsisVLA-4D，一个统一且高效的框架，用于增强 3D 感知和 4D 推理中的时空一致性。具体而言，我们设计了：1）CV-Aligner，通过筛选与指令相关的区域并在多个视角之间对齐对象身份，确保跨视角的对象语义一致性；2）CO-Fuser，利用紧凑的 latent representation 消除跨视角对象之间空间关系的歧义，从而保证跨对象的空间几何一致性。在此基础上，我们进一步提出 3）CS-Thinker，以在动作展开过程中实现跨场景的时空一致性。它从 CV-Aligner 的对象语义 token 中学习局部动力学的隐式知识，并从 CO-Fuser 的几何 token 中学习全局深度，从而在场景变化下增强高效视觉推理。大量实验表明，得益于其高效的时空一致性设计，ConsisVLA-4D 在 LIBERO 基准和真实平台上相较于 OpenVLA 分别实现了 21.6% 和 41.5% 的性能提升，以及 2.3 倍和 2.4 倍的推理加速。ConsisVLA-4D 已开源并公开可用。

items.title: Dream-MPC: Gradient-Based Model Predictive Control with Latent Imagination
items.summary: Dream-MPC 用学习到的 world model 与梯度优化式 MPC 提升连续控制中的策略与规划性能。
items.abstract_en: State-of-the-art model-based Reinforcement Learning (RL) approaches either use gradient-free, population-based methods for planning, learned policy networks, or a combination of policy networks and planning. Hybrid approaches that combine Model Predictive Control (MPC) with a learned model and a policy prior to leverage the advantages of both paradigms have shown promising results. However, these approaches typically rely on gradient-free optimization methods, which can be computationally expensive for high-dimensional control tasks. While gradient-based methods are a promising alternative, recent works have empirically shown that gradient-based methods often perform worse than their gradient-free counterparts. We propose Dream-MPC, a novel approach that generates few candidate trajectories from a rolled-out policy and optimizes each trajectory by gradient ascent using a learned world model, uncertainty regularization and amortization of optimization iterations over time by reusing previously optimized actions. Our results on 24 continuous control tasks show that Dream-MPC can significantly improve the performance of the underlying policy and can outperform gradient-free MPC and state-of-the-art baselines. We will open source our code and more at https://dream-mpc.github.io.
items.one_liner_zh: Dream-MPC 用学习到的 world model 与梯度优化式 MPC 提升连续控制中的策略与规划性能。
items.summary_cn: 当前最先进的基于模型的强化学习（RL）方法，要么在规划中使用无梯度的群体式方法，要么使用学习得到的策略网络，或者结合策略网络与规划。将模型预测控制（MPC）、学习到的模型以及策略先验结合起来的混合方法，因能够利用两种范式的优势而展现出良好前景。然而，这些方法通常依赖无梯度优化方法，而这类方法在高维控制任务中计算代价较高。尽管基于梯度的方法是一个很有前景的替代方案，近期工作在实验上表明，基于梯度的方法往往表现不如其无梯度对应方法。我们提出 Dream-MPC，这是一种新方法：先由滚动展开的策略生成少量候选轨迹，再利用学习得到的 world model、基于不确定性的正则化，以及通过重用先前已优化动作来在时间上摊销优化迭代，从而对每条轨迹执行梯度上升优化。我们在 24 个连续控制任务上的结果表明，Dream-MPC 能显著提升底层策略的性能，并且能够优于无梯度 MPC 和当前最先进的基线方法。我们将在 https://dream-mpc.github.io 开源代码及更多内容。

items.title: From Pixels to Tokens: A Systematic Study of Latent Action Supervision for Vision-Language-Action Models
items.summary: 系统比较图像式与动作式 latent action 监督策略，指出离散 latent action token 直接监督 VLM 的 VLA 训练效果最佳。
items.abstract_en: Latent actions serve as an intermediate representation that enables consistent modeling of vision-language-action (VLA) models across heterogeneous datasets. However, approaches to supervising VLAs with latent actions are fragmented and lack a systematic comparison. This work structures the study of latent action supervision from two perspectives: (i) regularizing the trajectory via image-based latent actions, and (ii) unifying the target space with action-based latent actions. Under a unified VLA baseline, we instantiate and compare four representative integration strategies. Our results reveal a formulation-task correspondence: image-based latent actions benefit long-horizon reasoning and scene-level generalization, whereas action-based latent actions excel at complex motor coordination. Furthermore, we find that directly supervising the VLM with discrete latent action tokens yields the most effective performance. Finally, our experiments offer initial insights into the benefits of latent action supervision in mixed-data, suggesting a promising direction for VLA training. Code is available at https://github.com/RUCKBReasoning/From_Pixels_to_Tokens.
items.one_liner_zh: 系统比较图像式与动作式 latent action 监督策略，指出离散 latent action token 直接监督 VLM 的 VLA 训练效果最佳。
items.summary_cn: Latent action 作为一种中间表示，使得 vision-language-action (VLA) 模型能够在异构数据集上进行一致建模。然而，使用 latent action 监督 VLA 的方法较为碎片化，缺乏系统性比较。本文从两个角度组织对 latent action 监督的研究：(i) 通过基于图像的 latent action 对轨迹进行正则化；(ii) 通过基于动作的 latent action 统一目标空间。在统一的 VLA 基线下，我们实例化并比较了四种代表性的集成策略。结果揭示了公式化与任务之间的对应关系：基于图像的 latent action 有利于长时程推理和场景级泛化，而基于动作的 latent action 更擅长复杂运动协调。此外，我们发现，使用离散 latent action token 直接监督 VLM 能得到最有效的性能。最后，我们的实验为 latent action 监督在混合数据中的收益提供了初步见解，表明这是一条很有前景的 VLA 训练方向。代码见 https://github.com/RUCKBReasoning/From_Pixels_to_Tokens。

items.title: Counterfactual identifiability beyond global monotonicity: non-monotone triangular structural causal models
items.summary: 提出非单调三角结构因果模型与 CausalInverter，在 MuJoCo 操作任务中提升反事实恢复能力，为具身控制中的世界模型建模提供新识别条件。
items.abstract_en: Structural causal models provide a unified semantics for interventions and counterfactuals, but most identifiability results rely on restrictive assumptions like global monotonicity, which are often violated in embodied interaction, where the same exogenous perturbation can induce opposite responses under different contact contexts. We ask what structure still suffices once global monotonicity is dropped. We introduce non-monotone triangular structural causal models (NM-TM-SCM), which retain triangular recursion but replace global monotonicity with mechanism-wise invertibility and context-independent inverse transport. We prove that these conditions are equivalent to exogenous isomorphism and imply complete counterfactual identifiability, and we give a counterexample showing that local invertibility alone is insufficient. We instantiate the theory in CausalInverter, with triangular invertible layers, orientation gates, and transport-stability regularization. On synthetic non-monotonic mechanisms, the structural bias yields systematic counterfactual gains as non-monotonicity increases. On MuJoCo Door, our model achieves perfect event-level counterfactual recovery, lowers continuous angle error relative to a Transformer baseline, and delivers substantially more stable recovery than Transformer and conditional-flow predictors. On MuJoCo Push, where non-monotonicity is weaker, the same low-data predictors remain competitive or better, consistent with a bias-variance boundary. These results identify a broader identifiable regime between globally monotone triangular models and unconstrained black-box world models.
items.one_liner_zh: 提出非单调三角结构因果模型与 CausalInverter，在 MuJoCo 操作任务中提升反事实恢复能力，为具身控制中的世界模型建模提供新识别条件。
items.summary_cn: 结构因果模型为干预和反事实提供了统一语义，但大多数可识别性结果依赖于全局单调性等限制性假设，而这些假设在具身交互中常常被违反，因为同一外生扰动在不同接触上下文下可能引起相反的响应。我们探讨了在去除全局单调性之后，什么样的结构仍然足够。我们引入了非单调三角结构因果模型（NM-TM-SCM），其保留了三角递归结构，但用机制级可逆性和上下文无关的逆传输替代了全局单调性。我们证明这些条件等价于外生同构，并蕴含完整的反事实可识别性；同时我们给出了一个反例，说明仅有局部可逆性是不充分的。我们在 CausalInverter 中实例化了这一理论，该模型包含三角可逆层、方向门控以及传输稳定性正则化。在合成的非单调机制上，随着非单调性增强，这种结构偏置带来了系统性的反事实收益。在 MuJoCo Door 上，我们的模型实现了完美的事件级反事实恢复，相比 Transformer 基线降低了连续角度误差，并且比 Transformer 和条件流预测器提供了显著更稳定的恢复。在非单调性较弱的 MuJoCo Push 上，这些低数据预测器同样具有竞争力或表现更好，这与偏差-方差边界一致。这些结果识别出了一个更广泛的可识别区域，位于全局单调的三角模型与无约束黑盒世界模型之间。
